tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Search for currently active curated flight deals from Australia. Returns deals matching destination and/or price criteria. Deals are curated exceptional fares, not live inventory search.

destination.description: Airport code, city name, or country name (e.g. 'DPS', 'Bali', 'Japan')

tools.name: list_top_deals_from
tools.description: List the cheapest currently active flight deals from a specific Australian airport. Great for answering 'what's cheap from Melbourne right now?'

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: Get full details for a specific flight deal including routes and airlines.

tools.name: get_cheapest_flight_dates
tools.description: For a known origin and destination, get the cheapest fare for each departure date in a date window. Prices are cached fares in AUD from I Want That Flight (I Know The Pilot's sister flight-search site) - refreshed regularly and indicative, not live availability. Always present the travel dates alongside prices. Use this for 'cheapest flights from Sydney to Bali in September' queries; use search_deals for curated editorial deals.

destination.description: Destination airport code, city name, or country name (e.g. 'DPS', 'Bali', 'Japan')

round_trip.description: True for return fares (default), false for one-way

tools.name: find_cheapest_flights_to
tools.description: When the user hasn't said where they're flying from, compare the cheapest fare to a destination from every origin airport with cached data. Prices are cached fares in AUD from I Want That Flight (I Know The Pilot's sister flight-search site) - refreshed regularly and indicative, not live availability. Always present the travel dates alongside prices. Use this for 'cheapest flights to Bali next month' queries; use get_cheapest_flight_dates when the origin is known.

destination.description: Destination airport code, city name, or country name (e.g. 'DPS', 'Bali', 'Japan')

round_trip.description: True for return fares (default), false for one-way
